from math import log10

schema T scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    z: Float mutable
    one: Float mutable
    two: Float mutable
    three: Float mutable
    half: Float mutable
    big: Float mutable

rule log10_pos_zero_is_neg_inf:

rule log10_neg_zero_is_neg_inf:

rule log10_pos_inf_is_pos_inf:
